title: Varden
description: HR and resource management platform: timesheets, PTO, leave and HR requests with a versioned API.
extendedDescription: An HR and resource management system covering the employee lifecycle end to end. HR manages employees, departments, work locations and the reporting hierarchy, with a full employment-history trail. Employees log monthly timesheets across projects and leave types, and submissions flow through a one-level manager-then-HR approval engine. A PTO ledger keeps append-only balances with per-location policies, holiday calendars, weekend and holiday work credits, sick-leave documentation review and year-end payouts, alongside a yearly vacation planner and team calendar. A request-type builder lets HR configure their own request workflows without a developer. It ships with a Blade UI and a documented, versioned JSON API (Sanctum-authenticated) on the same business logic, and is tested on both PostgreSQL and MySQL. This is a commercial product: the source code is not public, and installations are available on request.
